summary: Edit & Re-submit feature (Aug 2026) verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_resubmit.py — auth/ownership (401/403/404), business rules (409 for not-priced/outside-14d/already-retracted, 400 for missing billing acceptance), happy path (FB-XXX -> FB-XXX-v2 -> FB-XXX-v3 chain, correct version bump, original marked retracted with retracted_at/retracted_by/replaced_by_ref/replaced_by_id, original_ref backfilled), photos with Cloudinary URLs passed through untouched, /submissions/my hides retracted, /history exposes retracted (bucket='retracted') with replaced_by_ref, /stats/deal-outcomes excludes retracted (deal_done/sold counts decrement post-retract), /admin/submissions and /admin/submissions/counts include a 'retracted' bucket count. Frontend (Expo mobile, 390x844, dealer dave@fourbuy.co.za): 18 resubmit buttons visible on /submissions for priced-within-14d subs; testID='resubmit-btn-<id>' present as expected. Tapping the button (with window.confirm autoaccepted) navigated to /submit?resubmit_from=<id>; the Submit screen (a) rendered the amber banner testID='resubmit-banner' with copy 'Re-submitting FB-000186 · The original will be retracted on submit. R50 applies once Fourbuy prices the new version.', (b) changed the header to 'EDIT & RE-SUBMIT', and (c) prefilled all editable fields (Make BMW, Fuel Diesel, Year 2022, Transmission Automatic, Model X5 UITEST, Derivative xDrive30d etc). After a real chain was created (seeded FB-000187 priced -> API resubmit -> FB-000187-v2), History showed the amber testID='retracted-pill' reading 'RETRACTED · REPLACED BY FB-000187-v2' on the original and testID='replaces-pill' reading 'REPLACES FB-000187' on the -v2, while My Evaluations only listed FB-000187-v2 (retracted original correctly hidden). Dealer password (Dave1234!) was still valid so no admin reset was required this iteration.
action_items: None — feature is functionally complete and behaves per spec.

(Optional / cosmetic) The retracted-pill uses `borderColor` amber (#B45309) with a small icon; on a dark background it renders correctly but the pill has no fill (transparent). Consider a light amber tint (#B4530922) to match the existing UNSEEN pill styling for consistency.

(Optional / cosmetic) Retracted rows in History currently show only reference + year (the make/model are blank for FB-000187 in the screenshot — seed side-effect since my helper omitted make_name/model_name on that path). Real submissions created via /api/submissions carry these fields, so this is a seed-data artefact, NOT a bug. Flagged only in case the main agent wants to make history rows more resilient to missing make/model on legacy retracted rows.
critical_code_review_comments: next_version_reference() correctly handles all three chain-lookup paths (original_ref, exact reference, and `-vN` regex). Highest-version resolution is O(n) per chain but n is bounded by version count — fine at this scale.

The resubmit endpoint calls _build_submission_doc AFTER verifying business rules but BEFORE flipping the original to retracted. If _build_submission_doc raises (e.g. Cloudinary hiccup) the original remains un-retracted — correct.
The dealer's `active=False` suspension check is enforced in the resubmit endpoint (403 same as create). Good.
compute_bucket returns 'retracted' before the status/date checks — this correctly overrides any 'archived' status a priced sub would otherwise fall into.
billing_accepted is required per-resubmit — matches spec ('R50 applies · no waiver') and prevents accidental re-submits.

One subtle issue: RESUBMIT_WINDOW_DAYS is defined as a Python constant (14) on the server, and the mobile app duplicates it as a client-side constant in submissions.tsx. If the server value changes in future, the mobile grey-out window will drift. Suggest surfacing via /api/config or embedding into /submissions/my response so the client cannot drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button visibility, confirm modal, resubmit_from param, banner, header title, field prefill, /submissions/my hides retracted, /history shows both pills)

The 14 backend-test seeded submissions were all cleaned up by the pytest teardown fixture.

FB-000186 (73eabcf0-ecdf-4609-a880-c7a17abfd3d6) is a priced submission owned by Dave, still within the 14-day window — safe to use for further resubmit manual verification. rca_of_issue: No bugs. The initial pytest run failed with 422/401 errors because (a) my seed payload used pre-refactor field names (make_name/model_name/mileage_km/year/warranty_status) instead of the current VehicleSubmission schema (make/model/mileage/year_of_production/year_registered/factory_warranty_status), and (b) the admin password-reset endpoint expects `new_password` not `password`. Both were test-side issues — I fixed the payload and re-ran to green. No production code was modified.
